$comment: Invite codes. extractInviteCode(text): uppercase the first maxInputLength characters; find the first match of pattern; join the three groups with '-'. No match: null. Alphabet ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789 (no 0/O, 1/I/L), same as proseio-api newInviteCode(). Separators between groups: none, one space, or one hyphen or dash (U+002D, U+2010 to U+2014, U+2212). Portable: ICU (Swift), java.util.regex (Kotlin), V8 (JS). Cases: test-vectors/invite-codes.json.
